findings.criterion: Field value and complete external outcome
findings.observation: The current production workspace now directly closes both screenshot and TXT intake through explicit identity, exact-evidence review, human fact decisions, Wiki compilation, No action, and exact People readback. The same build proves slow cancellation, retry, duplicate handling, and mobile recovery. A separately authorized external effect, cross-day supersession, and comparison with working recruiters remain outside this internal contact-management artifact.
findings.evidence: docs/evaluations/2026-08-10-workspace-playwright-goal-completion-proof.json; docs/evaluations/2026-08-10-workspace-screenshot-cancellation-runtime-proof.json; dimension trace trigger_relevance=3, capture_burden=3, evidence_review=3, state_integrity=3, action_usefulness=2, write_safety=2, interruption_recovery=2, wedge_discipline=3.
findings.user_impact: A recruiter can turn either a screenshot or a reviewed TXT conversation into a durable, searchable relationship record without accidental action or duplicate facts, while measured advantage over existing notes, ATS, and calendar habits remains unproven.
findings.recommendation: Keep the release claim scoped to internal relationship intelligence, then test one separately authorized external effect, one day-later changed-evidence return, and at least five consented fallback comparisons.
findings.verification: The external slice previews the exact target and effect, executes at most once, verifies the destination, safely retries or reconciles failure, and field cases reduce reconstruction without increasing unsupported confirmation or cleanup.

strengths: Image and text now converge on the same relationship page, governed Wiki, and People directory instead of becoming separate tools.
The TXT journey exposes source authority clearly: recruiter and unknown messages remain visible but cannot become candidate facts.
No action, duplicate retained, cancel, and retry are treated as legitimate operational outcomes rather than dead ends.
The interface keeps the person, relationship context, exact source, current state, and next move together without ranking a person.
missing_evidence: One authorized external-effect preview, execution, observed-result, retry, and recovery loop.
Day-later return with superseded, retracted, expired, or deleted evidence.
Timed comparison and repeated-use evidence from working independent recruiters.
open_questions: Which recruiter-owned effect is frequent enough to justify the first separately reviewed write loop without turning the product into generic CRM work?
